The result is read     synchronously from the precompile call return value \u2014 NO callback.   - Image analysis uses precompile 0x0818 (long-running async). The contract stores this     ciphertext verbatim in events \u2014 it NEVER sees plaintext and cannot decrypt.   - One short-running async precompile per tx (LLM).
